'''Evie''' is a Non-Player Character (NPC) in the game. She is the daughter of King Gortius and Queen Miriam. In the Prime Elysia timeline, her counterpart is [[Nia (character)|Nia]].

==In-Game Appearance==
As an NPC character, Evie's first appearance is in Grand Quest - The Echoing Void.
